snippet.title: CookieRun: OvenSmash 💥 | Fight for Your Wish (Official Teaser)
snippet.description:
👇 Pre-register for CookieRun: OvenSmash now!
https://ckie.run/092f4b

👉 Share the Official Teaser and Get an Exclusive Costume Set!
- Help us hit 50,000 shares and reposts of the official teaser!
- How to Participate: Share the official teaser on YouTube or repost it on X.
- Reward: GingerBrave's special costume (Summer Spirit Set)

👉 Subscribe & Follow Event!
- Help us reach 100,000 subscribers on YouTube and 100,000 followers on X!
- How to Participate: Subscribe to our official YouTube channel and follow us on X.
- Reward: In-game currency worth approx. $20 (USD)

👉 Follow the official CookieRun: OvenSmash channels and stay up to date!
